entries.text: ClickHouse `create_schema` writes its table DDL with `translate_ddl` (MergeTree engine, `Nullable` only for the columns the benchmark schema marks nullable, tuned `PARTITION BY` / `ORDER BY` / `PRIMARY KEY`) instead of the adapter's own text rewriting. The adapter's `_optimize_table_definition`, `_strip_primary_key_constraints` and `Nullable`/key text helpers are removed. Types are spelled the ClickHouse way (`Int32`, `String`, `Decimal(15, 2)`, `DateTime`), and tuned key columns that are nullable fail with the table name and the column names. Cases are listed in `tests/unit/sql_compat/golden_corpus/recorded/area_ddl.json`.
